items.title: Assassins
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Become the master of the blade, and let no mob out of your sight! 

*12 assassins
*2 skins free

items.title: Dreamscape
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
From wacky illusions to scary nightmares, relive all of your dreams with this pack!

*16 dream skins
*2 skins free

items.title: Craftable Modern City
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Hey builder, are you ready to build a huge city? Moreover, there is no need to struggle, just collect the necessary materials and put the structure you want in the plots! You can build your dream city and start a new life with your friends! 

- Cars and helicopter included
- 40+ different structures to craft
- 2 free skins
- All buildings are furnitured

items.title: Farmers Paradise
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to live on a farm? You can live the farming life of your dreams in this amazing barnyard! Tend your fields, feed your animals, harvest your crops, and more in this amazing map!

- Tons of areas to roleplay in and explore!
- Perfect for enhancing the survival experience!

items.title: Modern Beach House
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Do you like taking a holiday on a giant millionaire island with a boat? Roleplay in this world and discover your modern beach house with furniture interiors, drive your luxury car, fly a helicopter & cruise on a jetski. Be a trillionaire and live the perfect lifestyle you want!

+ Modern house
+ Drivable 3D vehicles with sounds
+ Custom 500x500 terrain

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Stonks
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Buy low, sell high! Trade stonks with villagers. Test your diamond hands and wait for a short squeeze. When the time is right, sell your stonks for a huge profit. Become a millionaire and buy luxury vehicles like yachts, helicopters, sports cars, and more.
- Mine for crypto
- 15 vehicles
- Memes
- 5 skins
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer fun

Make money fast!

items.title: Humanoid Planets
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
With one small step for humanity, it's time to put on your spacesuit and start the adventure. Play through the Minecraft solar system as the wonderful shapes and colors of the planets in their humanoid form.

- One totally free skin.
- Fourteen skins 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Armor Expansion
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Craft yourself a variety of EPIC armor in ARMOR EXPANSION! TNT, vampire, ninja, cat, cactus, and many more! Any type of ARMOR you can think of is here! Even use EMERALD or OBSIDIAN to CRAFT sets!

+ 25+ NEW ARMORS!
+ Unique EFFECTS & ABILITIES!
+ SLIME, BEE, & CAKE SETS!
+ UNDYING, LAPIS, RABBIT, & BEDROCK SETS!

items.title: Legend Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Be a legend teen with any of these 12 trendy and fashionable skins. Whether you want a fun demon skin with horns, pink gradient hair, or just want to look casual and cool, you'll find your next favorite skin in this beautiful pack! With modern skin designs and HD details, you'll look great!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 total skins

items.title: Baddest Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
We are the baddest out there! We live the fast life, and our style shows it! Do you wanna tag along?

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute, fashionable attire inspired by the baddest!

items.title: Resource Golems
items.creator: stonemasons
items.description:
All the resources have come to life! Explore the temple city of Resource Golems, and farm them for items with shears or TNT. Maybe you'll get lucky, and be rewarded with special drops!

*20 unique new mobs
*60 textures- see the impact of battle on the Golems
*21 Temples to discover - visit the Golems in their own personal arena
*Collect all the Golem noses! (unique drop)

items.title: Trendy Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Get ready to dress in style with the latest trending fashion for teens! Whether you're looking for a cool new jacket or a complete modern makeover, this skin pack is perfect for any person looking for a teen skin. 

- 12 trendy teen skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Hero Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to save the world? With this pack, your dreams of becoming a superhero will come true! Transform into a teenage hero and face evil!

- 10 cool skins!
- Perfect for roleplaying games 
- By Arkitex Studios

items.title: Frog Fashion 2021
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you like frogs? If so, then this pack is perfect for you! Wear these frog-styled outfits and impress everyone with your cuteness!

- 12 frog-themed skins
- 2 free skins!
- By Rvan Studios

items.title: Animals
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
RAWR! Do you like animals? If so, then you will love this pack! These adorable creatures are now the perfect skins for role-playing! With a wide variety of animals, these skins are perfect for oceans, forests, and even towns and cities!

+ 12 awesome skins!
+ 2 free skins
+ Role-play and teen-friendly! 
+ By Block Tale Studios

items.title: Crafting Factory
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to experience a unique crafting world? This factory has everything you'll need! Check out the recipe book, collect the required items, and place them on the crafting bench!

+ Detailed base and factory
+ Advanced zipline system and helicopter
+ Great for your survival experience
+ 4 skins perfect for roleplay
+ By Withercore

items.title: Bikes, Scooters & Skateboards
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft bikes, scooters, skateboards, roller skates, and more! Get some speed on the half pipes and do a 180. Ice skate over the water and it will turn to ice. Go for a ride on a tricycle, hoverboard, or even a longboard.
- 12 sports vehicles to ride and craft
- Large city to play in
- Angry Grandmas with canes
- 50 collectibles
- 5 skins

Catch some air!

items.title: Caves and Cliffs Style
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Swim alongside Axolotls in a matching onesie! Nimbly traverse cliffs dressed as a Goat! Light up the ocean floor in Glow Squid style! 

- 10 cute Axolotl, Goat, and Glow Squid outfits!
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Electric Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The stylish demons are here! They are trendy and ready for an adventure. Pick your favorite skin from among all of these colors and conquer the Minecraft world!

- 12 colorful skins
- 1 skin free
- Licensed by Dragon Blocks and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Turbo Parkour Time Trial
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
The clock is ticking! Jump from block to block all across the sky and avoid the pitfalls! Time your jumps carefully! Will you take a little extra time and ensure you don't fall or will you rush through to victory? Can you get lucky and score an S rating?

- Includes an extensive parkour course!
- Resets upon completion so you can try to best your last time!

items.title: It's Only One Level
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
It's only one level, how difficult could it be? Think outside the box to reach the button while facing a variety of challenges, ranging from time trials to parkour and more!

+ Fun and challenging puzzles
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Super Star City
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to be a movie star in this superstar city? Drive around in fancy sports cars because you are rich now! Be anything you want to be in Super Star City!

+ 3 sports cars included!
+ City home with mansions!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Dark Anime
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you a fan of dark styles? If so, this pack is perfect for you! This skin pack is perfect for those who love darker anime aesthetic.

+ 12 Skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Demons
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Are you evil? Roleplay as a demon and own the night! Multiple skins to choose from!
